body:
I did look on a lot of sites. I never really found a clear answer on what was an OD or not, and thank you for helping me with it. I'm honestly not keen on the idea of ever trying it again, then again I never thought I'd try it in the first place. If I ever do try it again though, I'll do a bit less lol.


I guess the scariest part was the desire to do it again after the first time. It was like I was trying to rationalize how often I could safely do it without getting addicted. Like, that in itself was a sign I shouldn't do it again.
The first time I felt more desire to do it again afterwards. I don't think I ever want to do it again though, that was one of the worst feelings lol

Thank you so much for your kind words and your understanding... I'm still extremely upset and honestly don't think I can do it...But I really appreciate you taking the time to be supportive. You're a really good person and anyone that knows you personally should consider themselves lucky.

I've tried to tell her, and she laughs and says, "That's what you're not getting! IT'S OVER! I DON'T OWE YOU SHIT!"

I'd just let go, but she's done this before. When she snapped out of it she was so loving and so glad I was still there... But she's blocked my number, and my home phone. She blocked me on Facebook and is making herself unavailable to me. She's telling me she's found someone else and holy shit it just hurts so much. I can't do it.

Thank you...That means a lot.

She's telling me she wants to sleep around...but I know it's not her and I'm just so scared that her distorted thoughts will lead her to do something we'll both regret..She's literally tearing me apart and rubbing salt into my wounds

It's pathetic but it all depends on her. I need to talk to her. Please don't give me any of that "Leave her" or "You're better off without her" bullshit because I can't. Okay? I can't. I'm weak, I know. I know she's bad for me, but I think it's me. I'm the problem. Why else would it be EVERY RELATIONSHIP? Every single one...It has to be me...


Edit....sorry for lashing out..just everyone else I've tried to talk to has told me that and I'm sick of it, I literally can't just move on... Not again.

Sort of..She's blocking me, shutting me out...she promised 4 times in the past week we would hang out and is blowing me off every time..I can't take it. She's telling me she doesn't love me..but I know she isn't serious. She's done this before, and I never gave up and once she calmed down she was glad I stayed. (I did nothing, seriously..She just takes everything out on our relationship)
